shortDescription: Manage volume snapshots on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the volume snapshot. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.

options.name: source_volume
options.description: UUID of the volume this snapshot belongs to. If I(name) and I(source_volume) are present, a new volume snapshot is created. This parameter has no effect on existing volume snapshots (I(uuid) option is present).

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assigned to the volume snapshot. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.
